Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable.

knowledge-chunk-52842de80b62ef7e4885762c.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-56711f9c8f451fa1fe406e48.content:
## 礼品卡

礼品卡支付差错申请须提供原交易流水和重复扣款记录；处理前不能承诺退回个人指定银行卡。
knowledge-chunk-56711f9c8f451fa1fe406e48.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-586a036a531be57f53ce55a8.content:

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 降噪耳机 | 降噪耳机主机拆封不等于卫生耗材可退；已启封的一次性入耳套不退，质量故障需单独审核。 |
knowledge-chunk-586a036a531be57f53ce55a8.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-725da5ef843c227d59a7d388.content:

| --- | --- |
| 洗碗机D62 | 洗碗机D62不能用插线板替代接地插座，也不能将排水管临时放在无固定措施的桶内运行。 |
knowledge-chunk-725da5ef843c227d59a7d388.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-73af43e8ab5f0d6c43d7ca41.content:
## 墨盒I82

墨盒I82安装前核对机身型号和墨盒地区编码，移除运输封条后装入对应槽位，不强行改装触点。
knowledge-chunk-73af43e8ab5f0d6c43d7ca41.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-7c25ed788b239dcf25636ffa.content:
## 折叠餐桌

折叠餐桌质量退货审核通过后报销标准寄回运费；非质量退货运费由买家承担，不报销保价费。
knowledge-chunk-7c25ed788b239dcf25636ffa.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-894105368a296f26e52fa2ab.content:
## 机械秤T78

机械秤T78移至硬地面后先空载调零，再平稳站上称量；不同地面读数不能直接解释为体重变化。
knowledge-chunk-894105368a296f26e52fa2ab.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-8c82e377c77382e558324a8a.content:

定制窗帘按买家确认图制作，不适用单纯不喜欢颜色的无理由退货。

knowledge-chunk-8d750e3861c9f753f40e897b.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-aa6dd6be5287079e6310e881.content:

无人机D87按标记装入后旋紧锁扣，轻拉确认固定，再检查各桨无裂纹且转动不干涉，完成检查后才接电。

人体工学椅试用期为签收后十四日，普通试用退货要求保留原包装且无明显污损。

Wix Stores: Delivering Digital Products
Digital products are downloadable files such as music files, illustrations, images, or ebooks.Important:Taxation regulations for digital goods vary by location. Check with your local tax authority to see what taxes apply.In this article, learn more about:
Delivering digital files Resending digital filesDelivering digital filesWhen you sell a digital product, the file is delivered to your customer as soon as the payment is received.
Immediate payment received: As soon as you receive online payment (e.g. credit card, PayPal, etc.), a confirmation email is sent to the customer with a download link. The link also appears on the Thank You page. Delayed payment: When payment does not arrive immediately (e.g. manual payment or echeck), a download link is not included in the confirmation email. After you receive payment and manually mark the order as Paid, a second email is sent to your customer with the download link.Sales with both digital and physical products:A sale that includes digital and physical products is marked as fulfilled only after the physical products are shipped. Resending digital filesThe download link sent to customers is active for 30 days. After that, it no longer works. You can resend a file to your customer at any time.To resend a digital file:
Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click to select the relevant order. Click the More Actions icon . Click Resend Download Link.

Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable.

Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable.

Wix Payments: Understanding the Status of Your Account
Wix Payments is not yet available for all users.After connecting Wix Payments as a payment method, your account can have one of the below statuses, depending on a number of factors (e.g. whether you've filled in all the relevant information, or if you account requires verification). To check your account status:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable.

Wix Payments is not yet available for all users.After connecting Wix Payments as a payment method, your account can have one of the below statuses, depending on a number of factors (e.g. whether you've filled in all the relevant information, or if you account requires verification). To check your account status:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable.

Wix Bookings Request: Offering 24/7 Availability for Appointments
Wix Bookings currently does not support setting appointments with true 24/7 availability. This feature would allow businesses to offer appointments at any time of day, every day of the week, without any gaps in availability. Workaround:To offer 24/7 availability in Wix Bookings, you can set each day from 00:00 to 00:00 (+1 day) both as default hours and for staff hours. 
Note: Setting hours from 00:00 to 23:59 leaves one minute unaccounted for and can cause issues with availability. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

Wix Restaurants: Changing the Pickup Hours for Orders
Important:
This article is about the original Restaurants Orders app.  We've released a new online ordering app. Learn how to add and set up the new Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app.Set what times are convenient for customers to pick up their orders. You can set pickup during open hours or set specific hours that work with your schedule. For example, setting a pickup time starting at 12pm ensures customers arrive for their lunch orders at lunchtime.To change restaurant pickup hours:
Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Pickup tab. Hover over the Hours field and click Edit to change your pickup hours. Choose how you want to set your pickup hours:
    
Opening Hours: Pickup is available during your restaurant's opening hours. Custom Hours: Set specific days and hours where pickup is available: 
        
Select the days. Select or deselect the 24 hours checkbox:
            
Selected: Customers can pick up their orders at any time. Deselected: You set specific hours when customers pickup their orders.   (Optional) Click the Add + icon to add another day and/or time range. For example you could set one pickup window for Monday - Thursday from 9AM-5PM and another for Friday - Saturday from 9AM-11PM.     Click Apply. Click Save at the top right.Note:You can also enable or disable the toggle  in the Pickup tab to temporarily disable the pickup option for your restaurant. If disabled, customers cannot go to your restaurant to pick up orders.

本版适用于2026年6月1日起大陆官网购买的商品。版本和渠道不同不可混用。
knowledge-chunk-251d58815e4305756f2a6051.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-3261804689ac04bd25d36a7c.content:
## 电子书E64

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 电子书E64 | 电子书E64下载的付费内容不随硬件退货自动退款；是否存在内容费用须依据实际购买情况，不能由登录推断。 |
knowledge-chunk-3261804689ac04bd25d36a7c.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-33c163e7ef68d13ba024f6c8.content:
## 吸尘器V64

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 吸尘器V64 | 吸尘器V64可水洗滤网不代表整机支持湿吸；该型号没有可切换的湿吸模式。 |
knowledge-chunk-33c163e7ef68d13ba024f6c8.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-380f35222e63a89ab87e3abf.content:
# 模拟星河商城 · 中国大陆官网 · 适用条件手册

本版适用于2026年6月1日起大陆官网购买的商品。版本和渠道不同不可混用。
knowledge-chunk-380f35222e63a89ab87e3abf.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-3c96aa115885ab9567922046.content:
## 电子书E64

电子书E64退回前应备份个人文件、退出账号并恢复出厂设置，硬件退款按分摊实付金额处理。
knowledge-chunk-3c96aa115885ab9567922046.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-3f7c82f8bfdc9ef70fb8bc86.content:
## 电饭煲Q79

电饭煲Q79先选择支持预约的菜单再设置完成时长，确认食材适用后启动；屏幕预约图标不代表已经开始加热。
knowledge-chunk-3f7c82f8bfdc9ef70fb8bc86.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-4350dcce757bed6db3a62c88.content:
## 风扇F69

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 风扇F69 | 风扇F69断电后原定时设置清除，恢复供电不会自动恢复运行；智能插座通电不能代替开机操作。 |
knowledge-chunk-4350dcce757bed6db3a62c88.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-4414be5d74ac3b09999041e0.content:
## 路由器R72

路由器R72支持2.4GHz和5GHz，不支持6GHz；Wi-Fi 6是协议名称，不等同于6GHz频段。
knowledge-chunk-4414be5d74ac3b09999041e0.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-45750b01d47b7a8c6c2750b3.content:
## 洗碗机D62

洗碗机D62缺少接口时先完成水电改造，再预约安装并进行空载漏水测试；预约不代表改造已完成。
knowledge-chunk-45750b01d47b7a8c6c2750b3.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-52842de80b62ef7e4885762c.content:
## 折叠餐桌

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 折叠餐桌 | 折叠餐桌因部件开裂申请质量处理时不受未组装条件限制；颜色不喜欢不属于部件开裂。 |
knowledge-chunk-52842de80b62ef7e4885762c.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-62f40e57a6b0695bc5bd8bf9.content:
## 咖啡机

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 咖啡机 | 咖啡机加入咖啡粉或奶液后不适用普通试用退货；出厂漏水可凭试机视频申请质量审核。 |
knowledge-chunk-62f40e57a6b0695bc5bd8bf9.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-65f32d47f82a776bccafcb18.content:
## 咖啡机

咖啡机签收十五日内的试用退货须保留包装，使用清水测试不视为制作饮品。
knowledge-chunk-65f32d47f82a776bccafcb18.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-6603a1f96f9fe199ae79d79a.content:
## 礼品卡

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 礼品卡 | 礼品卡因重复扣款发生的差错不属于余额提现，须按支付差错审核处理。 |
knowledge-chunk-6603a1f96f9fe199ae79d79a.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-695702cadb45d8f6fa9f5b4f.content:
## 电饭煲Q79

电饭煲Q79预约时长表示预计完成时间，而不是开始加热时间。
knowledge-chunk-695702cadb45d8f6fa9f5b4f.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-725da5ef843c227d59a7d388.content:
## 洗碗机D62

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 洗碗机D62 | 洗碗机D62不能用插线板替代接地插座，也不能将排水管临时放在无固定措施的桶内运行。 |
knowledge-chunk-725da5ef843c227d59a7d388.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-87687ad1213d9c4e99f815f6.content:
## 门锁L82

门锁L82外部USB只提供临时应急电源，不给内部电池充电。
knowledge-chunk-87687ad1213d9c4e99f815f6.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-8c18ab8dc614ebda28446b79.content:
## 电子书E64

电子书E64签收十四日内可试用退货，登录账号本身不取消试用资格。
knowledge-chunk-8c18ab8dc614ebda28446b79.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-8c82e377c77382e558324a8a.content:
## 定制窗帘

定制窗帘按买家确认图制作，不适用单纯不喜欢颜色的无理由退货。
knowledge-chunk-8c82e377c77382e558324a8a.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-99a6f541149e8b6b781a8294.content:
## 光伏充电板P96

光伏充电板P96接线前核对电源输入铭牌与极性，先遮挡面板再连接，禁止未经核算直接串联接入。
knowledge-chunk-99a6f541149e8b6b781a8294.title: 大陆官网现行办理与操作指引

knowledge-chunk-9c7a08f238b4012f5b31fecd.content:
## 净水器W73

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 净水器W73 | 净水器W73只能使用型号清单内的滤芯；外形相同的通用滤芯不保证密封及过滤性能。 |
knowledge-chunk-9c7a08f238b4012f5b31fecd.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-a34db82b64516be94ba3a859.content:
## 手环B68

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 手环B68 | 手环B68恢复出厂设置会清除尚未同步的记录；手机端已同步记录不会因手环重置自动删除。 |
knowledge-chunk-a34db82b64516be94ba3a859.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-a4bc3ac6e06e93790479b7d0.content:
## 墨盒I82

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 墨盒I82 | 墨盒I82的地区编码须与打印机地区一致，同系列但不同地区编码也可能不识别。 |
knowledge-chunk-a4bc3ac6e06e93790479b7d0.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-aa15276f1435a0534c3735a5.content:
## 生鲜水果

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 生鲜水果 | 生鲜水果因买家收到后常温放置超过约定时限而变质不适用到货腐坏规则，单纯口味偏好也不适用。 |
knowledge-chunk-aa15276f1435a0534c3735a5.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-aa1bc0266b534562d0a45bde.content:
## 键盘K86

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 键盘K86 | 键盘K86有三个记忆通道，但记住三台不代表同一通道可同时向三台输入；有线模式不能执行蓝牙配对。 |
knowledge-chunk-aa1bc0266b534562d0a45bde.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-ab0273579f7dae00ce691ebb.content:
## 组合洗护套装

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 组合洗护套装 | 组合洗护套装退货后不满足赠品门槛的须退回未使用赠品；赠品已使用时按下单时明确的赠品计价扣减。 |
knowledge-chunk-ab0273579f7dae00ce691ebb.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-ad3d04688212e4fd5eb9cb5d.content:
## 温控杯U75

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 温控杯U75 | 温控杯U75杯底电触点潮湿时不能放回通电底座；防溅接口不代表可以冲洗带电底座。 |
knowledge-chunk-ad3d04688212e4fd5eb9cb5d.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-ae65d4732ae4213e74690ac9.content:
## 组合洗护套装

组合洗护套装允许未启封单品部分退货，退款按订单中该单品分摊的实付金额计算。
knowledge-chunk-ae65d4732ae4213e74690ac9.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-b30eff213f2d420714b92de9.content:
## 光伏充电板P96

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 光伏充电板P96 | 光伏充电板P96插头外形一致不证明电压和极性兼容，串联两块后开路电压可能超出单块适配范围。 |
knowledge-chunk-b30eff213f2d420714b92de9.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-bb9cdd30c019cc3fa13d88fe.content:
## 无人机D87

无人机D87更换螺旋桨前应关机并断开电池。
knowledge-chunk-bb9cdd30c019cc3fa13d88fe.title: 大陆官网现行适用条件手册

knowledge-chunk-c1b04e88343111d634566073.content:
## 电饭煲Q79

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 电饭煲Q79 | 电饭煲Q79不建议将含奶等易腐食材长时间常温预约；普通白米预约功能不能证明奶粥可安全放置一夜。 |
knowledge-chunk-c1b04e88343111d634566073.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

knowledge-chunk-df3f3955874f6f7b3d4eefc2.content:
## 人体工学椅

| 商品 | 限制及例外 |
| --- | --- |
| 人体工学椅 | 人体工学椅气杆故障经审核确认后可按质量流程处理，不以保留原包装作为质量申请前提。 |
knowledge-chunk-df3f3955874f6f7b3d4eefc2.title: 大陆官网现行例外与兼容限制表

## 净水器W73

净水器W73复位只重置滤芯使用计时，不能恢复旧滤芯的过滤能力。

## 墨盒I82

墨盒I82兼容表：P82支持，P83支持，P84不支持；外观相同不能作为兼容依据。

Wix Restaurants: Allowing Customers to Place Orders for a Future Date
Important:
This article is about the original Restaurants Orders app. We've released a new online ordering app. Learn how to add and set up the new Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app.You can give customers the option of placing orders a few hours or days before the delivery time. For example, a bakery needs a few days notice in order to bake and decorate a birthday or a wedding cake. You can set a minimum time in advance (e.g. 3 days) that customers need to book in order to get their order delivered when they want it.Tip:Do you have a catering business? To learn how to transform your site into a catering site, click here.To enable future ordering:
Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Order scheduling. Click the Scheduled orders toggle to enable and set how far in advance customers can place an order: 
    
Minimum time: Enter a number and select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list.
Note: This is the minimum time customers can place a future order in advance. Maximum time: Enter a maximum number and select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list.
Note: This is the maximum time customers can place a future order in advance.   (Optional) Disable the ASAP toggle to accept future orders only. Click Save.Note:If you require customers to pick a delivery date and time, the Order Now button is inactive until your customer chooses a time.

Wix Payments: Understanding the Status of Your Account
Wix Payments is not yet available for all users.After connecting Wix Payments as a payment method, your account can have one of the below statuses, depending on a number of factors (e.g. whether you've filled in all the relevant information, or if you account requires verification). To check your account status:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable. 

Note: After your account is active, you may still be required to go through the

Wix Payments: Understanding the Status of Your Account
Wix Payments is not yet available for all users.After connecting Wix Payments as a payment method, your account can have one of the below statuses, depending on a number of factors (e.g. whether you've filled in all the relevant information, or if you account requires verification). To check your account status:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the status next to the relevant payment method.Select a status below to learn more:PendingYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you cannot yet accept payments.

To start accepting payments, you need to:
Publish your site. Upgrade it to a Wix Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments.Accepting PaymentsYou have connected your Wix Payments account to your site, but you have not completed the account setup or verification process.

You can accept payments (customers can complete their purchases), but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account.

To complete your account set-up:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Setup. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit.Learn more about account set-up.
Important: 
Wix is required to review and verify the personal and business information you provide as well as your site content. In some cases, we may need your cooperation in order to complete the verification process. From the time of the first transaction on your site, you have 30 days to complete your account setup or verification process. If you do not complete these processes within 30 days, your Wix Payments account will be suspended and you will not be able to accept payments through your site. ActiveYou have connected your Wix Payments account and your site is accepting payments. You are all set to receive weekly payouts to your bank account when applicable.

These need to be uploaded to your Wix Payments Dashboard to verify your identity. This may take up to 7 business days. If you do not complete your account setup within 30 days, we will be required to suspend your Wix Payments account.
